subject: general
question: India hosted the 2025 Men's FIH Hockey Junior World Cup. Which of the following correctly states the location, host city name, and timing of this event?

options.text: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, from December 1 to December 15, 2025
Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from November 15 to November 30, 2025
Chennai and Madurai, Tamil Nadu, from November 28 to December 10, 2025
New Delhi, at Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium, from December 20 to December 31, 2025

solution: The correct answer is __**Chennai and Madurai, Tamil Nadu, from November 28 to December 10, 2025**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • **India** is set to host the **2025 Men's FIH Hockey Junior World Cup**, marking a significant event in the global hockey calendar. • The correct host cities for this prestigious tournament are **Chennai and Madurai**, located in the state of **Tamil Nadu**, India. • The event will take place from **November 28 to December 10, 2025**, showcasing top junior hockey talent from around the world. • Chennai and Madurai are chosen for their **world-class sports infrastructure** and strong hockey culture, making them ideal hosts for this international event. • The tournament will serve as an opportunity for young hockey players to **gain international exposure** and contribute to the development of the sport in India.
